target.statement: MIM trained on TEXTBIND achieves a CLIP Similarity of 0.673 on Turn-3 image generation in TEXTBINDEVAL, outperforming SDXL (0.608) and GILL (0.530).

compute.basis: Training MIM requires 8 A100 GPUs for 5 epochs on 12M image-caption pairs plus instruction tuning, and TEXTBINDEVAL is not publicly released; reproducing the target would need re-creating the dataset and full training.

blockers: No code or model weights released
Needs 12M image-caption pairs for alignment stage
title: TextBind: Multi-turn Interleaved Multimodal Instruction-following in the Wild
